source: You have stuck to the party line on this issue.
zh: 在这个问题上你坚持党的路线。

source: I see what you're doing, and I like it. It might not be a bad thing to compromise on some issues outside of silver coinage.
zh: 我看到你在做什么，我喜欢它。在银币之外的一些问题上妥协也许不是坏事。

source: You have drifted a little far from your core beliefs here. Farmers are upset with you.
zh: 你在这里偏离了你的核心信念。农民们对你很不满。

source: Boos and hisses from the audience! This is what the 'Boy Orator of the Platte' came to talk about?!
zh: 观众的嘘声和嘶嘶声！这就是“普拉特男孩演说家”来谈论的事情？！

source: One of your favorite lines -- and a favorite of your supporters also.
zh: 你最喜欢的台词之一——也是你的支持者最喜欢的台词。

source: You have aligned yourself with Coxey and his army. We'll see how that turns out.
zh: 你已经与考克西和他的军队结盟了。我们将看看结果如何。

source: What? You're supposed to be a man of the people, not of the trusts.
zh: 什么？你应该是人民的人，而不是信托的人。

source: This view is a little out of the mainstream, but not that much.
zh: 这种观点有点脱离主流，但也不是那么严重。

source: Are you taking the side of Grover Cleveland over that of hard-working American railroad men?
zh: 您是否站在格罗弗·克利夫兰一边，而不是勤奋的美国铁路工人一边？

source: This is another case where your earnest Christian beliefs might be better left unstated.
zh: 这是另一种情况，您最好不要说出您真诚的基督教信仰。

source: You cannot close Pandora's Box. Fifteen percent of Americans were born abroad and they will not abide by this rhetoric.
zh: 你无法关闭潘多拉魔盒。百分之十五的美国人出生在国外，他们不会遵守这种言论。

source: What is your interpretation of the antitrust statutes? Do large American business profit from monopolistic practices?
zh: 您对反垄断法规有何解释？美国大企业是否从垄断行为中获利？

source: John Palmer, a Gold Democrat, is also running against Bryan. He has offered to remove his name from the ballot on the East and West Coast if you will do the same in the South. He argues that this will consolidate the anti-Bryan vote. What do you think?
zh: 约翰·帕尔默，一名金民主党人，也在竞选布赖恩。他提出，如果你愿意在南部做同样的事情，他将把自己的名字从东海岸和西海岸的选票中删除。他认为这将巩固反对布赖恩的投票。你怎么认为？

source: Is it generally appropriate for federal courts to issue injunctions against striking unions?
zh: 联邦法院发布针对工会罢工的禁令通常是否合适？

source: Do you think that there should be federal oversight of the New York and Chicago trading markets?
zh: 您认为纽约州和芝加哥交易市场应该受到联邦监督吗？

source: Grover Cleveland led the push to repeal the Sherman Silver Purchase Act in 1894. What are your thoughts on his actions during that period?
zh: 格罗弗·克利夫兰 (Grover Cleveland) 领导推动废除 1894 年《谢尔曼白银购买法案》。您对他在此期间的行为有何看法？

source: Some labor leaders have called for regulation standardizing a ten or even an eight hour workday. Do you support these calls?
zh: 一些劳工领袖呼吁制定法规，将十小时甚至八小时的工作日标准化。你支持这些呼吁吗？

source: The Wilson-Gorman Tariff Act of 1894 lowered the rates on many goods, while still falling well short of Cleveland's ideal levels. What do you think about this act as a whole?
zh: 1894 年的威尔逊-戈尔曼关税法案降低了许多商品的税率，但仍远低于克利夫兰的理想水平。您对整个行为有何看法？

source: In general, is the Supreme Court too obstructionist in their rulings on economic issues? Would you appoint judges who would bring a new perspective to these issues?
zh: 总体而言，最高法院对经济问题的裁决是否过于阻挠？您会任命能够为这些问题带来新视角的法官吗？

source: Would you support a program to compensate workers who are injured on the job? Is this a proper responsibility of the federal government?
zh: 您是否支持一项补偿因工受伤工人的计划？这是联邦政府应有的责任吗？

source: What do you have to say about William Jennings Bryan's campaign, at a high level?
zh: 您对威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩的活动有什么高层次的看法？

source: Bryan combines vague, non-sensical appeals to emotion with a near-blasphemous use of religious symbolism. I'm confident that the voters will reject this demagogue.
zh: 布赖恩将模糊、无意义的情感诉求与近乎亵渎的宗教象征主义结合起来。我相信选民会拒绝这个煽动者。

source: Free coinage of silver will debase our currency and make a mockery of us to the rest of the world.
zh: 自由铸造白银将使我们的货币贬值，并让世界其他地方嘲笑我们。

source: William Jennings Bryan is a devout, honest man. It's unfortunate that he proposes such misguided policies.
zh: 威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩是一个虔诚、诚实的人。不幸的是，他提出了如此误导性的政策。

source: Our campaign is much better positioned to address the concerns of ordinary Americans than Bryan's. He is overly focused on the silver issue.
zh: 我们的竞选活动比布赖恩的竞选活动更能解决普通美国人的担忧。他过于关注白银问题。

source: Absolutely not. Can you imagine how it would look if we removed ourselves from the ticket in any state? And for an old man like Palmer?
zh: 绝对不是。你能想象如果我们在任何州将自己从罚单中删除会是什么样子吗？那么对于像帕尔默这样的老人呢？

source: If Palmer will remove himself from the ballot in Kentucky, Indiana, West Virginia, Maryland, and Delaware, then I will give him free reign in the Deep South.
zh: 如果帕尔默将从肯塔基州、印第安纳州、西弗吉尼亚州、马里兰州和特拉华州的选票中删除自己，那么我将给予他在深南部的自由统治权。

source: I hope Palmer will see fit to remove himself unilaterally from the most hotly contested border states. His is purely a protest candidacy however, and I cannot remove myself from a ballot on his behalf without looking like a buffoon.
zh: 我希望帕尔默认为单方面从争议最激烈的边境州撤出是合适的。然而，他纯粹是一个抗议候选人，我不能代表他从选票中退出，否则看起来就像个小丑。

source: I am willing to make an expansive deal with Palmer. He may remain on the ballot in Illinois, but must remove himself completely from the other northern states. In turn I will give him free reign in the entire South.
zh: 我愿意与帕尔默达成一项广泛的协议。他可能会留在伊利诺伊州的选票上，但必须完全远离其他北部各州。反过来，我将给予他在整个南方的自由统治权。

source: I support the coinage of silver, and this action was a step in the wrong direction. It took money out of the system when we needed it the most, and is partly to blame for the depth of our current downturn.
zh: 我支持白银铸币，这一行动是朝着错误方向迈出的一步。当我们最需要的时候，它从系统中抽走了资金，这也是我们当前经济严重衰退的部分原因。

source: Unfortunately the Treasury was bankrupt. I do think that Cleveland approached this in the usual heavy-handed, abrasive manner, but he was absolutely in the right. This whole episode demonstrates the folly of silver coinage.
zh: 不幸的是，财政部破产了。我确实认为克利夫兰以惯常的严厉、粗暴的方式处理了这个问题，但他绝对是正确的。整个事件证明了银币的愚蠢之处。

source: We can criticize Cleveland for a lot of things, but his repeal of the Silver Purchase Act is not one of them. I supported Cleveland all the way in the repeal debate.
zh: 我们可以批评克利夫兰的很多事情，但他废除白银购买法案并不是其中之一。我在废除辩论中一直支持克利夫兰。

source: We would also like to move a little more in the direction of lower tariffs, but overall this is a good law.
zh: 我们还希望朝着降低关税的方向进一步努力，但总的来说，这是一项很好的法律。

source: I am disappointed with the half measures taken in this act. If Senators were directly elected by the people, they would be less beholden to the types of financial interests who wrote their own tariffs into this law.
zh: 我对这一行为中采取的半措施感到失望。如果参议员由人民直接选举产生，他们就不会那么受那些将自己的关税写入该法律的经济利益集团的影响。

source: This act was the result of countless hours of compromise and negotiations. It's time we closed this issue and stopped changing our entire tariff system every time a new Administration takes over.
zh: 这一行为是无数小时妥协和谈判的结果。是时候我们解决这个问题并停止在每次新政府上任时改变我们的整个关税制度了。

source: My first action as President will be to reinstate higher tariffs. This is an American policy that supports American factories and American workers.
zh: 作为总统，我的第一个行动将是恢复更高的关税。这是支持美国工厂和美国工人的美国政策。

source: When I am President, you will finally have someone who takes our antitrust legislation seriously. I will break up monopolistic banks and railroads in places where they stifle competition.
zh: 当我担任总统时，你们终于会有一个认真对待我们的反垄断立法的人了。我将在扼杀竞争的地方打破垄断银行和铁路。

source: I take a very narrow view of the term "monopoly". There is a need for these statutes but they open up a lot of danger for political witch hunts.
zh: 我对“垄断”一词的看法非常狭隘。这些法规是必要的，但它们给政治迫害带来了很多危险。

source: I favor a hands-off approach to the economy. The federal government has no business stepping in and breaking a company into pieces.
zh: 我赞成对经济采取不干涉的态度。联邦政府无权介入并将一家公司拆散。

source: We absolutely need a federal program for this purpose. The Bible says that we must love all people -- even those who have been cast aside by our Darwinian industrial machinery.
zh: 为此目的，我们绝对需要一个联邦计划。圣经说我们必须爱所有人——即使是那些被达尔文工业机器抛弃的人。

source: This is more properly a state responsibility. It is outside the scope of the federal government to regulate working conditions in this manner.
zh: 更准确地说，这是国家责任。以这种方式规范工作条件不属于联邦政府的职责范围。

source: It is the responsibility of the worker to put aside such funds as are necessary to protect them from these events. This is why we have mutual aid societies in place.
zh: 工人有责任预留必要的资金以保护他们免受这些事件的影响。这就是我们设立互助协会的原因。

source: Not only would this greatly improve working conditions for Americans, it would increase employment by spreading our working hours amongst more people.
zh: 这不仅会极大地改善美国人的工作条件，还会通过将我们的工作时间分散到更多人身上来增加就业。

source: I am a strong supporter of labor, but I also think that working hour restrictions are more appropriate for women and children than for grown men.
zh: 我是劳工的坚定支持者，但我也认为工作时间限制更适合女性和儿童，而不是成年男性。

source: I do not see the authority for regulating this under the Commerce Clause of the Constitution. This is something that individual states would need to investigate.
zh: 我认为宪法的商业条款没有对此进行监管的权力。这是各个州需要调查的事情。

source: I don't believe that outside parties should regulate the working arrangements between a man and his employer.
zh: 我认为外部各方不应规范男性与其雇主之间的工作安排。

source: If we could manage it, I would increase the number of justices on the Court so that we can dissipate the influence of the reactionaries presently in control there.
zh: 如果我们能够做到这一点，我会增加法院法官的数量，以便我们能够消除目前控制在那里的反动派的影响力。

source: Absolutely. I will appoint sensible, assertive judges as President. The purpose of the Court is not to simply overturn half of the laws passed by Congress, on picayune Constitutional objections.
zh: 当然。我将任命明智、果断的法官担任总统。法院的目的并不是简单地因宪法反对而推翻国会通过的一半法律。

source: It is not my place as a politician, running for a position in the Executive Branch, to comment on the performance of the Court.
zh: 作为一名竞选行政部门职位的政治家，我没有资格对法院的表现发表评论。

source: The poor man is called a socialist if he believes that the wealth of the rich should be divided among the poor, but the rich man is called a financier if he devises a plan by which the pittance of the poor can be converted to his use.
zh: 如果穷人相信富人的财富应该分给穷人，那么他就被称为社会主义者；但如果富人制定了一项计划，可以将穷人的微薄之物转化为他的用途，那么他就被称为金融家。

source: It was stock market and railroad company chicanery which caused the Panic of 1893. Sensible regulation of this process could have saved us all a lot of trouble.
zh: 正是股票市场和铁路公司的欺骗行为导致了 1893 年的恐慌。对这一过程的明智监管本来可以为我们所有人省去很多麻烦。

source: The New York Stock Exchange is a private company providing liquidity to other companies. The last thing our fragile economy needs is some hare-brained intervention in this process.
zh: 纽约州证券交易所是一家向其他公司提供流动性的私营公司。我们脆弱的经济最不需要的就是在这一过程中进行一些轻率的干预。

source: There has already been considerable reform of the stock markets since the dangerous days of the 1860s. There's no need to take this idea any further.
zh: 自 1860 年代的危险时期以来，股票市场已经进行了相当大的改革。没有必要再继续这个想法了。

source: The use of injunctions is a favored court tactic for union busting and it must stop. I support the right of striking workers to picket their workplace while on strike.
zh: 使用禁令是法庭打击工会的常用策略，必须停止。我支持罢工工人在罢工期间在工作场所设置纠察线的权利。

source: Maybe in limited cases, where unions are a threat to public safety or where they undermine an essential industry. The courts are notoriously conservative, however, and definitely take this practice too far.
zh: 也许在有限的情况下，工会对公共安全构成威胁或破坏了重要行业。然而，法院是出了名的保守，而且这种做法肯定太过分了。

source: The Pullman Strike of 1894 disrupted half of the nation's rail traffic and threatened to throw our society into complete turmoil. A small group of radicals should never have the power to disrupt the lives of millions.
zh: 1894 年的普尔曼罢工扰乱了全国一半的铁路交通，并有可能使我们的社会陷入彻底的混乱。一小群激进分子永远不应该拥有扰乱数百万人生活的力量。

source: You have echoed the concern of many immigrants and moderates that Bryan is a religious fundamentalist.
zh: 您回应了许多移民和温和派的担忧，即布赖恩是宗教原教旨主义者。

source: You should also be concerned about appearances. If you receive 0 votes in the entire South, you may well lose the national popular vote like Harrison in 1888 even while you win the election.
zh: 你还应该关心外表。如果你在整个南方获得0票，即使你赢得了选举，你也很可能会像1888年的哈里森一样失去全国普选票。

source: This is a limited compromise. Palmer of course is an old man who will lose all of the states you conceded him, but every vote will count in Kentucky.
zh: 这是一个有限的妥协。帕尔默当然是一位老人，他将失去你让给他的所有州，但每一张选票都将计入肯塔基州。

source: You may win a close state without Palmer on the ballot, but your willingness to cut this deal has the whiff of a scandal in certain quarters.
zh: 你可能会在没有帕尔默的情况下赢得一个势均力敌的州，但你愿意达成这项协议在某些方面带有丑闻的味道。

source: Keep pointing out the practical problems associated with silver coinage so that Americans can make an informed decision this November.
zh: 继续指出与银币相关的实际问题，以便美国人能够在今年 11 月做出明智的决定。

source: Frightening comments to hear from a so-called Republican!
zh: 从所谓的共和党人那里听到的可怕评论！

source: Businessmen are confused about your apparent disregard for law and order.
zh: 商人对你对法律与秩序的明显漠视感到困惑。

source: It's a bit uncomfortable when you discuss the near bankruptcy of the Treasury. After all, wouldn't silver coinage just cause this same problem again?
zh: 当你讨论财政部濒临破产时，这有点不舒服。毕竟，银币不会再次引发同样的问题吗？

source: Your supporters hate the railroads, and you should fall in line with their wishes.
zh: 你的支持者讨厌铁路，你应该符合他们的意愿。

source: Workers are hoping you would take a stronger stand on this, as the man of the people in this election.
zh: 工人们希望您在这次选举中作为人民的代表，在此问题上采取更强硬的立场。

source: Jacob Coxey's protests fell on deaf ears in 1894. With so many men out of work, is there any role for a public works program that would keep them occupied until business improves?
zh: 1894 年，雅各布·考克西 (Jacob Coxey) 的抗议被置若罔闻。在如此多的人失业的情况下，公共工程计划是否可以发挥作用，让他们有事可做，直到生意好转？

source: What do you have to say about your own Christian faith? And how does it inform your political views?
zh: 对于你自己的基督教信仰，你有什么话要说的？它如何影响你的政治观点？

source: Do you believe that the federal government should monitor and improve important waterways in the interests of commerce, such as the Mississippi River?
zh: 您是否认为联邦政府应该为了商业利益而监控和改善重要的水道，例如密西西比州河流？

source: John Rockefeller is concerned about the possible effects of the Sherman Antitrust Act, passed in 1890. It seems that certain rabble-rousers believe this law should be used to break up Standard Oil. Can you reassure him that you will take a narrow interpretation of this law in your Administration?
zh: 约翰洛克菲勒担心 1890 年通过的《谢尔曼反托拉斯法》可能产生的影响。似乎某些煽动者认为应该利用这项法律来瓦解标准石油公司。你能否向他保证你会在你的政府中对这项法律采取狭隘的解释？

source: Today it looks like it's the Milwaukee Chamber of Commerce who have made the trip to your house. Do you have something inspiring to tell them in your speech?
zh: 今天看来是密尔沃基商会拜访了您家。您在演讲中有什么鼓舞人心的话要告诉他们吗？

source: I feel like discussing the incredible danger that Bryan represents to our Republic.
zh: 我想讨论布赖恩对我们共和国所带来的难以置信的危险。

source: I am a proud Methodist. We all pray to the same Christian God and there is no need to use divisive, radical religious rhetoric.
zh: 我是一名自豪的卫理公会教徒。我们都向同一个基督教上帝祈祷，没有必要使用分裂的、激进的宗教言论。

source: We all believe in God. I am just as Christian as Mr. Bryan. No more. No less.
zh: 我们都相信上帝。我和布赖恩先生一样是基督徒。不再。不少。

source: My faith calls for the true equality of man. Our Constitution enshrines the ideals that each man has God-given rights which cannot be ignored by any earthly power.
zh: 我的信仰呼吁人类真正平等。我们的宪法庄严宣扬这样的理想：每个人都拥有上帝赋予的权利，任何世俗权力都不能忽视这些权利。
